name: What types of exterior doors are available for replacement?

mainEntity.name: What types of exterior doors are available for replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common exterior door types include steel, fiberglass, and wood. Steel doors offer excellent security and durability, often at a lower cost. Fiberglass doors are energy-efficient, resistant to dents, and can mimic the look of wood. Wood doors provide a classic aesthetic and can be customized, but require more maintenance. Each material has different insulation properties, security features, and aesthetic options.
acceptedAnswer.description: Exterior door options include steel for security, fiberglass for durability and energy efficiency, and wood for classic aesthetics.
